<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/it-solution-request" exporter="BPMN Modeler" exporterVersion="1.0">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SubmitRequest" name="IT solution request submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SolutionRolledOut" name="Solution rolled out"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Requesting employee or department" processRef="Process_Requester"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_IT"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitRequest" name="Submit request" sourceRef="UserTask_SubmitRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RolloutNotice" name="Solution rolled out" sourceRef="Task_RollOutSolution" targetRef="CatchEvent_SolutionRolledOut"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Requester" name="Requesting employee or department" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Requester" name="">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SubmitRequest" name="Submit IT solution request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_SolutionRolledOut" name="Solution rolled out">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SolutionRolledOut" messageRef="Message_SolutionRolledOut"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Requester" name="Solution received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Requester" targetRef="UserTask_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R2" sourceRef="UserTask_SubmitRequest" targetRef="CatchEvent_SolutionRolledOut"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R3" sourceRef="CatchEvent_SolutionRolledOut" targetRef="EndEvent_Requester"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IT" name="IT" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="Request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_SubmitRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcureTools" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallSolution" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSolution" name="Test solution in controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RollOutSolution" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Split" name="Training provided?" default="Flow_NoTraining">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoTraining</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Join" name="Training handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoTraining</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideSupport" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Support" name="Support available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I2" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_ProcureTools">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I3" sourceRef="Task_ProcureTools" targetRef="Task_InstallSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I4" sourceRef="Task_InstallSolution" targetRef="Task_TestSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I5" sourceRef="Task_TestSolution" targetRef="Task_RollOutSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I6" sourceRef="Task_RollOutSolution" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${trainingProvided == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoTraining" name="No training" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I7" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I8" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Join" targetRef="Task_ProvideSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I9" sourceRef="Task_ProvideSupport" targetRef="EndEvent_Support"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_ITSolutionRequest">
